cases.description: Nearby high-quality hospitals, verified necessary-treatment affordability barrier without sufficient relief; strong technology production and diffusion; other capabilities have documented strengths and residual limits.

limitations: Capabilities are stipulated synthetic facts, not observations of named cities. Scores are holistic judgments under the accompanying document, not equal averages of subpillars. Neither cases nor their sensitivity settings establish actual candidate bounds or ranking eligibility. Real Singapore and London assessments remain unfinished.
